ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with a high-intensity (white) central region providing a stark macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central, vertically-oriented white geometric blob extends from the median notch to the lower peduncle interface. This is flanked by two large, contiguous dark pigmented regions. High-contrast white stippling is scattered across the dark lobes, concentrated primarily along the lower interior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70-75 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks increases towards the distal tips, while the mid-lobe sections exhibit lower-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward-sweeping curve on both lobes, terminating in acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white/grey pixel formations (consistent with barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Numerous isolated, sub-centimeter circular white spots are distributed across the dark ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent set of intersecting white linear pixel disruptions forms a large 'X' shape on the left lobe. Additional parallel diagonal linear marks are visible on the inner-left lobe and fainter horizontal linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional cross-hatched scarring on the left lobe. Significant biological encrustation visible at both lobe tips causing localized silhouette distortion.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'feathered' boundary interface between the central white pigment patch and the dark lateral pigmentation.
